title: Associate Analyst, Data and Finance (Energy Efficiency)
why_fit: 0-3 years; budget projections, KPI reports and vendor-payment reconciliation match my AMG work almost task for task.
why_us: This role projects Energy Efficiency budgets across three states, checks accounting and budgeting data for accuracy, supports monthly KPI and financial reports, and reconciles vendor payment and production data against internal systems. That list reads like my job at AMG, where I build the budget and monthly forecasts, report KPIs to ownership, and automated a weekly payment reconciliation in Python from 5 hours to 1. I like the idea of applying that to a regulated utility program, and Westwood is a reasonable drive from Belmont. The posting asks for 0-3 years, which fits.
cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am applying for the Associate Analyst, Data and Finance role on Eversource's Energy Efficiency team in Westwood. The posting asks for help projecting program budgets across three states, reviewing accounting and budgeting information for accuracy, supporting monthly KPI and financial reports, and reconciling vendor payment and production data against internal systems. I do very similar work today and would like to bring it to a larger organization.

As Financial Manager at AMG Family Dental since August 2023, I build the annual operating budget and monthly forecasts, run budget-versus-actual variance analysis and prepare KPI reports for ownership. I also oversee billing, collections and revenue tracking. By improving reporting and reconciliation in Dentrix, I identified and recovered more than $500,000 in annual revenue, and I automated a weekly insurance payment reconciliation in Python that cut processing time from 5 hours to 1 and flags underpaid claims for follow-up.

At Northrop Grumman I audited more than 100 financial models for accuracy, compliance and internal controls, and I analyzed supplier costs and budget variances across multiple programs while using SAP and Deltek Cobra to maintain data integrity.

I hold an M.A. in International Economics and Finance from Brandeis and a B.S. in Finance from Suffolk, and I use advanced Excel, SQL, Python and Tableau. I have not worked in the energy sector, so I would need to learn how the efficiency programs are funded and reported. I am a US citizen, so the sponsorship note does not affect me, I can work the hybrid schedule in Westwood, and I am available immediately. Thank you for your consideration.

Sincerely,
Alexander Airapetian

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am applying for the Investment Compliance Analyst role on the John Hancock fund compliance team in Boston. The job is about confirming that funds stay inside their prospectus, 1940 Act and tax diversification limits, and about holding sub-advisers to the same standard. My background is in checking numbers against rules, and I want to do that work in the fund industry.

At Northrop Grumman in 2022, I audited more than 100 financial models for accuracy, compliance and internal controls, and I used SAP and Deltek Cobra to keep program cost data clean. That work taught me to read a rulebook, test the output against it and write up what does not tie. At AMG Family Dental, where I have been Financial Manager since August 2023, I automated a weekly insurance payment reconciliation in Python. It cut processing time from 5 hours to 1 and flags underpaid claims, which is a small version of the monitoring and exception review your team does every day.

I should be direct about the gap. I have not worked in the mutual fund industry or used a dedicated compliance monitoring system, so the 40-Act specifics and sub-adviser due diligence would be new to me. I do bring a master's in International Economics and Finance from Brandeis, a finance degree from Suffolk, strong Excel and SQL skills, and a habit of documenting what I find so reviewers can follow it. I also present findings to senior people without softening them, which I did for leadership at Northrop and for ownership at AMG.

I live near Boston, I am a US citizen, and I can start immediately. I would welcome a conversation about how I can support the funds compliance team.

Sincerely,
Alexander Airapetian
